challenge.method: Bound the comparison to the heading through the final period of the specified sentence. Strip C comment line prefixes, lowercase the ASCII passage, tokenize with [a-z0-9]+, and compare ordered token arrays. Also test full-text equality and match both data URL pins to the annotated release tag.
challenge.results: The three bounded passages each yield 99 tokens in identical order. The raw project slice at bytes [112,790) differs from the SPDX slice at [33,682) in comment decoration and whitespace. The project also has a descriptive heading, author email, revision markers, and implementation outside the passage. The standalone and decoded licenseText are exactly equal at 683 bytes, and both pinned URLs match the annotated tag's target.

limitations: The match is confined to the bounded token sequence in the mirror-served project file and the two SPDX text representations. The project and SPDX full documents differ.
The SPDX standalone and detail share a data revision. The annotated tag is unsigned. Other versions, installation, reuse, and legal effect require separate evidence.
